name: lash.fork_rm
doc: Remove a Kiln fork (`kiln rm lash <name>`, which also stops its Bazel server and anything still running in it). Refused while the fork at `path` has tracked changes (staged or unstaged), or while its HEAD is not on origin/main (committed work that never landed), unless force; the refusal lists both, plus the untracked paths that would go. A landed fork with only untracked files left (lane evidence, logs) is removed, and `discarded` lists those paths. Never remove a fork any other way.
